notes.title: LHEA is releasing on September 22!
notes.content:
[p]Hello beautiful souls![/p][p][/p][p]The time has come. LHEA is pretty much done and we have selected Monday September 22 as our official release date![/p][p][/p][p]I will spend the next two weeks focusing on fixing a few bugs and testing / tweaking end game balancing.

It's been quite a journey to develop this game part-time for nearly three years and am super proud of the final result![/p][p][/p][p]I hope you'll all enjoy this unique adventure!![/p][p][/p][p]May the stars align in your favor.[/p]

notes.title: Release moved to September!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

We've been running a playtest on Android platform with 37 testers at the moment and are receiving extremely valuable feedback!

Most of it is super positive. Some of the points are also very interesting design challenges and we already have fun ideas to address these feedbacks!
[/p][p]Once this playtest is over, we want to wrap up all the new iterations into a second playtest, but this time for iPhones and iPad.

It is important for us to simultaneous launch the game on all three platforms - and to take the time to read and address important feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Therefore we are taking an extra month to finish up the 1.0 version of LHEA! We are aiming for September 22nd at the moment. Only two months away!


Stay tuned for a lot more updates in the upcoming weeks - things are moving quite fast![/p][p]Jo @ Soul Fuel Games[/p]

notes.title: Live streaming the demo today!
notes.content: [p]Let's play through LHEA's demo and talk a little bit about the different game features along the way![/p][p][/p][p]Come say hi! <3[/p]

notes.title: LHEA demo is now available!
notes.content:
Hello beautiful souls!

It is finally here, after 30 months of part-time development, LHEA and the Word Spirit demo is available to download!

The full demo lasts about an hour. You can decide if you want to play the introduction/tutorials (30 minutes) and then jump right in to the roguelite loop!

We hope you enjoy <3

--

Side note:

We are also running playtests in parallel and are actively collecting feedback.

There will be of course a lot more tweaks and development in the two months leading to launch!

If you'd like to share any feedback: info@soulfuelgames.com or DM us on our socials!
For any bugs you may encounter: https://soulfuelgames.freshdesk.com/support/home

notes.title: The birth of LHEA and the Word Spirit
notes.content:
Hello beautiful souls!

Today, on May 1st 2025, LHEA is now officially revealed to the public!

To celebrate, here is a quick summary of our roadmap for the next few months:

[b]May[/b]
[list]
[*] Continue creating the soundtrack
[*] Private playtests on Steam
[*] Finish audio for the Steam Next Fest demo & upload build
[/list]
[b]June[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam Next Fest! Watch streams, interact with community, address feedback
[*] Deploy the game on Android & iOS
[*] Private and public playtests on mobile
[/list]
[b]July[/b]
[list]
[*] Lots of surprises :D
[/list]
[b]August[/b]
[list]
[*] Launch!!! [i](Date should be announced in July)[/i]
[/list]
The launch is approaching so fast! We can't wait for everyone to be able to play LHEA.

May the stars align in your favor,
Soul Fuel Games
